from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancingRecord(BaseModel):
    """Extracted financial record from a single company report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company in the report")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by the document")
    metric_label: str | None = Field(description="The specific line item label in the cash flow statement")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the financing cash inflow")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="The currency unit for the amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financing_records: list[FinancingRecord]
